observed.caption: A paved city street lined with trees and parked cars leads toward colorful market stalls and distant high-rise buildings under a cloudy sky.
observed.description: The photo shows an outdoor urban street scene viewed at ground level. In the foreground a patterned paved sidewalk lined with black and white bollards runs along the left, with two prominent trees with thin dark trunks and green foliage in the center and left foreground. A gray asphalt road occupies the center and right, with a row of parked cars in white, silver and black along the right curb and additional vehicles further down the street. Two people are visible in the foreground, one walking on the sidewalk on the left and one in a light blue jacket and jeans crossing the street on the right while holding a phone. In the midground and background there are colorful market tents, a green and blue bus on the left, motorcycles, and more people gathered near the stalls. Tall buildings including a red and gray high-rise on the left, a beige multi-story building on the right with banners, and modern glass towers in the distant center are visible beyond dense green trees. The sky is overcast with gray clouds.
